content:
alex (Daybreak): hey team — we're kicking off a short POC. need a trial org + API keys. goal: private inference for 2 weeks, ~20 rps, evaluating latency on 8k context models. also need billing/spend cap and sample security attestation.

maria (Sales): thanks alex — quick Qs: which deployment mode do you want to test first (hosted API, dedicated pool, or private/VPC)? also attach preferred billing email for the org.

alex (Daybreak): prefer private/VPC for data controls, but open to hosted + VPC peering if it's faster. billing contact is finance@daybreak.ai. we expect < $5k spend for the POC, want a hard guard.

chris (Solutions): for a private/VPC POC we typically do two phases: 1) hosted API with ephemeral org + strict spend cap + short-lived API keys to validate correctness, 2) if perf looks good, spin up a mini dedicated pool or private node behind your VPC.

chris (Solutions): rough ETA: hosted trial setup ~1 business day, dedicated pool ~7–10 business days (capacity + provisioning), private/VPC ~5–10 days depending on network approvals.

sam (Infra): to unblock private/VPC we need these from Daybreak: VPC ID, egress CIDR permission, and an allowlist of IP ranges for our maintenance hooks. sample config we need from you: ```vpc_id: vpc-0a1b2c3d\nallowed_cidrs: ["10.0.0.0/16"]\nmaintenance_cidrs: ["3.120.45.0/24"]```

lena (FinOps): on billing — we can seed a trial org with $5,000 in promo credits and set a hard spend cap. For POCs under $10k we often use promo credits + daily spend cap (e.g., $200/day). If you require invoicing / PO, flag that now.

maria (Sales): @alex do you need invoice/PO or is promo credit + card enough? Also remind that Dedicated requires a signed SOW for reserved capacity.

alex (Daybreak): promo credits + spend cap works. no PO for this short POC. can you also limit model families to our approved set (gpt-large-8k, gpt-x-reduced) while testing?

chris (Solutions): yes we can restrict model access per-project. I'll add a model allowlist when creating the project. command I use internally to create the trial org (internal CLI snippet): ```rwctl orgs create --name daybreak-poc --billing_email finance@daybreak.ai --promo_credits 5000 --spend_cap 200 --model_allowlist gpt-large-8k,gpt-x-reduced```

sam (Infra): small note: for Dedicated we need a formal capacity request ticket. I'll open one now and link it here. If we end up going private on-prem later, lead time increases due to network / security reviews.

realtime-bot: ticket created: POC-789 (dedicated-capacity) — assignee: sam.

lena (FinOps): once org is created I will attach the promo credit and lock the spend cap. you'll get a billing project id, please keep it in your runbook. If you need per-route cost alerts, we can enable them temporarily.

maria (Sales): next steps: (1) Alex provide VPC details + CIDR and confirm model allowlist, (2) I create the trial org and tag it daybreak-poc, (3) FinOps seeds credits and sets caps, (4) Infra opens dedicated capacity ticket if you want baseline throughput. Sam will follow up with network checklist.

alex (Daybreak): sending VPC and CIDR in a separate secure email right now. thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

chris (Solutions): also linking security questionnaire: https://redwood.example/sq/daybreak-poc — fill and return to security@redwood.ai. we can fast-track SOC2 items for short POCs.

sam (Infra): for the network checklist I'll need firewall rules, NAT/GW info, and whether you want private peering or transit. putting the checklist in POC-789.

maria (Sales): I'll create the org today and ping when keys are ready. Expected first message update: tomorrow morning with the ephemeral API key and the billing project id.

alex (Daybreak): perfect. we'll validate latency and share results mid-POC. thanks everyone!

maria (Sales): great — action items noted. closing loop here once infra & finops confirm. :white_check_mark:
